title: Console UI MVP: create/manage route experiments (behind feature flag)
creator: Dylan Brooks
description:
## Summary
Implement the Console UI MVP for route-level experiments (A/B/n) so beta customers and internal teams can create and manage experiments safely. UI must be gated behind a feature flag and respect RBAC permissions.

This ticket covers the **MVP UI workflow**: list + details pages, creation flow (wizard), and basic actions (start/stop). Metrics/results dashboards are a separate follow-up (see results/dashboard tickets/PRs).

## Goals (MVP)
- Provide a usable UI to:
  - Create an experiment configuration (route + variants + traffic allocation + stickiness key + basic guardrails)
  - View experiment state (Draft/Running/Stopped/Degraded)
  - Start/Stop an experiment
  - See basic guardrail readouts + links to dashboards/runbooks (where available)
- Ensure everything is **behind a feature flag** (beta allowlist) and **RBAC-aware**.
- Keep the UI consistent with Rollouts patterns (existing canary + model version management surfaces).

## Non-goals (MVP)
- Statistical significance / automated analysis UI
- Custom metrics ingestion UI
- Cross-region rebalancing controls
- Full “audit diff viewer” experience (we can link to Audit Log with filter + show a lightweight change history section)

## UX surface area
### 1) Experiments list
- Route Experiments landing page under Rollouts
- Table columns (MVP): Name, Route, Status, Traffic (allocated %), Created by, Last updated
- Filters: Status, Route, Owner (self)
- Empty state: call-to-action to create (if permitted)

### 2) Experiment details
- Header: name + status pill + feature-flag banner (beta)
- Key fields (read-only summary): route, stickiness key, allocation, variants (model + rollout/fallback compatibility warnings), created/updated
- Guardrails section:
  - Show configured thresholds (latency/error/cost; quality if attached)
  - Show current guardrail status banner (OK/Degraded) based on API summary
  - Provide “View dashboards” deep link (Grafana) and runbook link when present
- Actions:
  - Start (Draft -> Running)
  - Stop (Running/Degraded -> Stopping -> Stopped)
  - Mutations disabled while Running unless explicitly supported by API (MVP: treat as immutable while Running; prompt user to Stop first)

### 3) Creation wizard (MVP)
- Step 1: Basics
  - name, description (optional)
  - route selector (from known routes)
  - eligibility rules (MVP: minimal; rely on backend validation)
- Step 2: Variants
  - Variant A/B(/C…) model selection
  - Show compatibility warnings inline (e.g., model not allowed on route tier)
  - Max variants: enforce GA default in UI (MVP: cap at 5; align with backend)
- Step 3: Traffic + stickiness
  - Allocation editor (sum to 100)
  - Stickiness key selection helper + guidance copy
  - Validation warning copy for missing/low-entropy stickiness keys (MVP: client-side warnings + backend errors)
- Step 4: Guardrails
  - Latency p99 delta, error rate delta, cost/token delta (defaults pre-filled)
  - “Auto-stop” settings: display as read-only / “not available in MVP” if backend not enabled in environment
- Step 5: Review + create (Draft)

## Feature flag + RBAC requirements
- Entire navigation entry + routes gated by feature flag: `route_experiments_ui` (name to match backend flag if possible; otherwise map in Console config)
- RBAC:
  - If user lacks view permission: hide experiments nav + direct URL should show permission denied
  - If user can view but not mutate: show details read-only; disable Create/Start/Stop
  - Buttons must be disabled client-side AND enforced by API (UI must handle 403 gracefully)

## API contracts (assumptions)
- List experiments endpoint supports pagination + basic filters (status/route)
- Details endpoint returns:
  - config summary
  - current state
  - guardrail status summary (OK/Degraded + reason strings)
  - audit/change history pointers (optional)
- Mutations:
  - create (Draft)
  - start
  - stop

## Acceptance criteria
- [x] UI is not visible without feature flag enabled
- [x] Users with view permission can:
  - see list page
  - open details page
  - read configured variants/allocations/guardrails
- [x] Users with mutate permission can:
  - create a Draft experiment via wizard
  - start Draft experiment
  - stop Running/Degraded experiment
- [x] UI handles common validation errors with actionable messaging:
  - allocation not 100%
  - overlapping experiment on route (if backend blocks)
  - missing/invalid stickiness key
- [x] Basic e2e coverage added (happy path create->start->stop behind flag)

## Implementation notes
- Reuse existing Rollouts layout components (tables, status pills, confirmation modals)
- Avoid high-cardinality queries in UI (do not call results endpoints from this MVP ticket)
- Prefer server-side validation as source of truth; keep client-side checks as best-effort UX

## Links
- Confluence PRD: route-level A/B testing PRD
- Confluence UX spec: Console route experiments UX spec
- GitHub PRs (implementation):
  - PR-28518 Console UI: experiments list + details
  - PR-28524 Console UI: experiment creation wizard

## Risks / open questions
- Stop semantics: do we show “Stopping” intermediate state vs. optimistic UI? (MVP: show intermediate state if returned by API; otherwise poll until Stopped)
- Overlapping experiments: if backend blocks, we need clear error copy + link to route’s active experiment
- Guardrails: ensure we don’t imply hard-stop behavior in UI (copy must reflect “soft-stop/notification” if that’s what’s enabled)

## QA / test plan
- Unit tests: form validation (allocation sums, variant count cap, permission gating)
- Integration/e2e: Cypress flow behind flag
  - enable flag -> create draft -> start -> stop -> verify list status updates
- Manual: verify 403/permission denied behavior using non-privileged role
